makemeahanzi.definition: to return, to turn around; a time

characterDeckComponents.note: 回 depicts a spiral or winding shape — something that turns back on itself, giving rise to the meaning 'to return.'

makemeahanzi.definition: appropriate, timely; to act, to serve; the sound of bells
to see, to observe, to meet, to appear

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 見; a man 儿 with the eye 目 emphasized

characterDeckComponents.note: 冂 (a simplified eye shape in 见's modern form) — emphasizes the act of seeing.
儿 (a person) — a person with an emphasized eye above gives 见 its meaning 'to see.'

meanings: unit of weight, one tenth of a tael 兩|两[liang3]

makemeahanzi.definition: money, currency, coins

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 钱 relates to money, since early Chinese coins were made of metal
戋 (jiān) gives a loose sound connection to 钱's reading qián

makemeahanzi.definition: to moan; interjection indicating pain or sadness

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 噢 is a sound made with the mouth, an interjection.
奥 (ào) gives a sound only distantly related to ō today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to eat; to drink; to suffer, to endure, to bear

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吃 relates to eating, done with the mouth
乞 (qǐ) gives a sound close to 吃's reading chī

meanings: (of ships, vehicles, troops etc) to start

makemeahanzi.definition: to open; to start, to initiate, to begin

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 開; hands 廾 lifting the latch 一 of a door

characterDeckComponents.note: 廾 (two hands) — depicts hands at work.
一 represents the latch or bar of a door; hands lifting it away gave 开 its meaning 'to open, to start.'

meanings: used in 傢伙|家伙[jia1 huo5] and 傢俱|家俱[jia1 ju4]
refers to the philosophical schools of pre-Han China

makemeahanzi.definition: house, home, residence; family

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 家 is about a home, the space under a roof.
豕 (shǐ, 'pig') supplies the ancient sound for 家; keeping a pig under one's roof was also a practical sign of a household in ancient China, though the modern readings jiā and shǐ no longer rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: which? where? how?

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — used when asking a question aloud
那 (nà) gives a sound close to 哪's reading nǎ, differing mainly in tone

makemeahanzi.definition: to go, to walk, to move; professional

etymology.hint: To take small steps 亍 with one's feet 彳

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 depicts a step with the left foot; together with 亍 (a step with the right foot), 行 shows a person walking or moving.
亍 depicts a step with the right foot, complementing 彳 to form the idea of walking or travel.

makemeahanzi.definition: in front, forward; former, preceding
an exclamation

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — the mouth radical, marking the character as related to speech, sound, or an action of the mouth.
海 (hǎi) gives a sound close to 嗨's reading hāi — the same syllable, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: the future, what will be; ready, prepared; a general

etymology.hint: Going to bed 丬 at night 夕, a predictable future

characterDeckComponents.note: 丬 (a stylized bed) — 将 originally pictured someone preparing for bed at night.
夕 (evening/night) — the coming of night was seen as predictable, giving 将 its meaning 'about to' or 'going to' happen.

makemeahanzi.definition: cart, vehicle; to move in a cart

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 車, a cart with two wheels, seen from above

characterDeckComponents.note: A simplified form of 車, a pictograph of a two-wheeled cart seen from above — the wheels, axle, and frame are visible in the original shape — the source of 车's meaning 'cart, vehicle.'

makemeahanzi.definition: time, season; period, era, age

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun/day) — relates to 时's meaning of 'time, season'; the phonetic part of the character was later replaced by 寸 in the simplified form

makemeahanzi.definition: to kill, to murder, to slaughter; to hurt

etymology.hint: To kill 乂 someone and bury them in a coffin 木

characterDeckComponents.note: 乂 depicts crossed strokes suggesting a cutting action.
木 (wood) here represents a wooden stake — giving 杀 its meaning 'to kill.'

makemeahanzi.definition: belch; hiccup

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 呃 (a hiccup, a filler word) comes from the mouth.
厄 (è) gives the sound — an exact match with 呃's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: small table; how many; a few, some

characterDeckComponents.note: 几 depicts a small low table or stool with legs — a simple domestic object.

makemeahanzi.definition: after; behind, rear; descendants
to compare, liken; comparison; than

etymology.hint: Two spoons 匕 side-by-side; 匕 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 比 is made of two identical 匕 (spoon) shapes placed side by side — comparing two similar things led to its meaning 'to compare.'

makemeahanzi.definition: little, few; rather, somewhat

characterDeckComponents.note: 二 (two) — 些 originally suggested a small plural amount, building on the idea of 'more than one.'
此 (cǐ) is the historical phonetic element; it no longer closely matches the modern reading xiē.

makemeahanzi.definition: to ask about, to inquire after

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 问 relates to speaking, specifically asking a question.
门 (mén) gives a hint of the sound — 问 is pronounced wèn, related but the tone and vowel have shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to begin, to initiate; to rise, to stand up

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (to walk/run) — 起 relates to standing up and setting into motion.
己 (jǐ) gives a close sound cue — 起 is pronounced qǐ, sharing the same final sound.

meanings: classifier for houses, small buildings, institutions etc
particle introducing a relative clause or passive

makemeahanzi.definition: place, location; "that which", a particle introducing a passive clause

etymology.hint: An axe 斤 swung at a door 户

characterDeckComponents.note: 户 (door) — 所 evokes a location or place, such as where a door stands.
斤 (axe) — combined with 户 (door), the image of an axe at a door gave rise to the abstract sense of 'a place' or 'that which.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to reside, to live at, to dwell, to lodge; to stop

etymology.hint: A person 亻 who hosts 主; 主 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — the one settling somewhere.
主 (host, master) — the idea of a person settled in a place as if hosting it, giving 住 its meaning 'to live, reside, stay.'

meanings: classifier for events, things, clothes etc

makemeahanzi.definition: item, matter; component, part; measure word for events

etymology.hint: A man 亻 dividing up a cow 牛

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 件 relates to a person separating something into parts.
牛 (ox) — dividing an ox into pieces gave 件 its meaning of an individual 'item' or 'piece,' now used as a measure word for objects and matters.

meanings: first month of the lunar year

makemeahanzi.definition: straight, right, proper, correct, just, true

etymology.hint: A foot 止 stopping in the right place 一

characterDeckComponents.note: 一 (a line, representing a target or standard) — 正 shows a foot arriving exactly at the right mark.
止 (foot, to stop) — arriving and stopping precisely at the target gives 正 its meaning of 'correct' or 'straight.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to combine, to annex; also, what's more

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 並; two men standing side-by-side

characterDeckComponents.note: 并 (simplified from 並) depicts two people standing side by side — giving its meaning of 'together' or 'and.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to release, to liberate, to free

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (a hand with an implement, action) — relates to 放's meaning 'to let go, release, put.'
方 (fāng) gives the sound — 放 is pronounced fàng, a close match sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to do, to fix, to make, to settle

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 搞 is a general verb for doing or handling something with the hands.
高 (gāo) gives a sound close to gǎo, sharing the same syllable body and differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: stick, club; strong, smart; to hit

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 棒 describes an object made of wood, a stick.
奉 (fèng) gives a sound only distantly related to bàng today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: mother, mama

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妈 refers to one's mother
马 (mǎ) gives a sound close to 妈's reading mā, differing only in tone

makemeahanzi.definition: earth, ground, soil; land, region; structural particle used before a verb

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth/soil) — 地's original meaning is 'earth, ground'
也 (yě) gives a partial sound match for 地's other reading dì; in this grammatical-particle usage the character is instead pronounced 'de'

makemeahanzi.definition: to advance, to make progress; to come in, to enter

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 进 relates to advancing or entering, both movement-related.
井 (jǐng) gives a close sound cue — 进 is pronounced jìn, sharing similar consonant and vowel sounds.

makemeahanzi.definition: new, recent, fresh, modern

etymology.hint: A freshly chopped 斤 tree 亲

characterDeckComponents.note: 亲 (here representing a tree, related to 榛/hazel) — 新 pictures a tree being cut.
斤 (an axe) — freshly chopping wood gave 新 its meaning of something 'new' or 'fresh.'

meanings: you (courteous, as opposed to informal 你[ni3])

makemeahanzi.definition: honorific for 'you'

etymology.hint: You 你 said with affection 心

characterDeckComponents.note: 你 (you) — the base pronoun
心 (heart) — added below to show warmth and respect toward the listener

makemeahanzi.definition: towards; direction, trend
three

etymology.hint: Three  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 二 (two)

characterDeckComponents.note: 三 is made of three simple horizontal strokes stacked together — the most direct way to picture the number three, following the same pattern as 一 (one) and 二 (two).

meanings: used in 唵嘛呢叭咪吽[an3 ma2 ni2 ba1 mi1 hong1]

makemeahanzi.definition: final exclamatory particle

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) shows 嘛 relates to speech, as a spoken particle.
麻 (má) gives a sound close to ma, differing mainly in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: old, aged; experienced

etymology.hint: A person bent over with long hair 匕 and a crutch; compare 耂

characterDeckComponents.note: 耂 (a person bent with age, with long hair) — depicts an elderly figure.
匕 (here representing a cane or walking stick) — combined with the bent figure above, 老 pictures an old person leaning on a cane.

makemeahanzi.definition: seat, throne; rank, status; position, location

etymology.hint: The place where a person 亻 stands 立

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 位 relates to a person's location.
立 (to stand) — the spot where a person stands gave 位 its meaning 'position' or 'place,' and later, a polite measure word for people.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drop, to fall, to remove

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 掉 relates to dropping something from the hand.
卓 (zhuó) reflects an older phonetic connection that has faded in the modern pronunciation diào.

makemeahanzi.definition: first, former, previous

etymology.hint: Someone stepping 止 in front of another person 儿

characterDeckComponents.note: 止 (a foot, stepping forward) — 先 pictures someone moving ahead of another.
儿 (a person) — one person stepping ahead of another gave 先 its meaning 'before' or 'first.'

makemeahanzi.definition: marks preceding phrase as modifier of following phrase; it, him her, them; to go to

etymology.hint: A foot meaning "to follow"; cursive version of 止

characterDeckComponents.note: A stylized foot (related to 止, 'to stop/foot') — originally meant 'to go,' later grammaticalized into a literary possessive/linking particle, similar to 的.

makemeahanzi.definition: to buy, to purchase; to bribe, to persuade
race, kind, breed; seed; to plant

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain/rice plant) — 种 relates to seeds and planting crops.
中 (zhōng) gives the sound — 种 is pronounced zhǒng, matching aside from tone.

meanings: person engaged in certain types of work
person skilled in certain types of work

makemeahanzi.definition: hand

etymology.hint: A hand with the fingers splayed

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 is a simple picture of an open hand with the fingers spread out.

makemeahanzi.definition: seat; to sit; to ride, to travel by

etymology.hint: Two people 从 sitting on the ground 土

characterDeckComponents.note: 从 (two people, one following another) — depicts people together.
土 (earth/ground) — two people seated on the ground gave 坐 its meaning 'to sit.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to drink; to shout, to call out

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 喝 describes an action of the mouth, drinking.
曷 (hé) gives the sound — an exact match with 喝.

makemeahanzi.definition: and; with; to; for; to give, to grant
